title: Locking collected ETH by triggering `createPoolAndAddLiquidity` twice
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  When users create a token in the Serious market, it can be funded by calling `buyToken` and providing the required amount of ETH and users will receive the requested amount of the token. Until the token is fully funded (`tokensSold >= tradeableSupply`), the collected ETH will be stored inside the `SeriousMarketProtocol` contract.
